tables.title: Applicability
rows: D1 · AUDA, SUDA, VUDA, RUDA, GUDA
Any zone where permissible base FSI is ≥1.2

tables.title: Permitted use
rows: Residential; Commercial; Recreational; Mixed use (any combination of the above)

tables.title: Abutting road
rows: Building unit must abut a Development Plan / Town Planning Scheme road at least 30.00 m wide

tables.title: Minimum area of building unit
rows: More than 100 m and up to 150 m

tables.title: Frontage
rows: Abutting on more than one road

tables.title: Minimum margins and separation
headers: Between podiums in same building unit
rows: More than 100 m and up to 150 m

notes: Chapter 12 scope: building height more than 100 m, or slenderness ratio (height / minimum width) of 9 or more.
Chapter 12 states no upper limit for building height; airport NOC, structural safety, EIA clearance, Fire Department NOC and other approvals apply.
Margins apply irrespective of abutting road width. Nothing except a portable security cabin may be permitted in the margins.
